main_panel: quality_usable and condition=manual and quality_use=ordinary_primary; frozen current-reference difficulty only
relative_quality: same-task centered least-squares worker fixed effect with equal-worker-zero anchor
joint three-difficulty partial pooling lambda=20, with lambda=5 and 80 fixed sensitivities
three independent difficulty effects lambda=0 diagnostic
missing: No quality, target time, source time, unsupported worker or unsupported class is filled with zero. Numerical fitted effects for thin cells remain estimates marked unsupported.

time.source_training: pool_analysis_eligible, manual, ordinary_difficulty_eligible, known current difficulty, positive source time; quality is a separate gate
time.target_training: same conditions with actual positive target_matched_time_seconds; never filled by source
time.main_relative: pooled same source-task (image,condition) adjusted worker effect; observational old/new provenance remains confounded with worker cohort
time.origin_sensitivity: separate origin/source-kind effects, each independently centered; not a cross-source calibration
time.relative_three_classes: fast below -log(1.25), slow at or above log(1.25), otherwise middle

coarse_labels.Q2: above-peer if beta >=0, below-peer otherwise; supported only
coarse_labels.Q3: above-peer if beta >=3; below-peer if beta <=-3; near-peer otherwise
coarse_labels.QT: Q2 x relative T2; no permanent natural-group claim
coarse_labels.difficulty_type: all three levels require support. across_strong: theta_e,theta_m,theta_h >=3; hard_specialist: theta_h>=3 and theta_h-theta_e>=3 and theta_h-theta_m>=3; hard_relative_lift_only: theta_h<3 with both contrasts>=3; hard_drop: both contrasts<=-3; otherwise mixed_or_near. Contrasts and support for easy and medium are also reported separately.
coarse_labels.hard_adaptation: up if hard-easy >=3 and hard-medium >=3; down if both <=-3; otherwise mixed_or_near; all three levels require support

fine_labels.merge_rule: within each exact QT parent, split into supported adaptation children only when at least two non-unknown children have >=3 workers; retain child labels only for children with >=3 workers, else retain parent with sparse_child suffix. Unknown adaptation retains parent with difficulty_unknown suffix.
fine_labels.purpose: finite interpretable candidate types, no retuning after fusion outcomes; report candidate and merged labels and true member lists

selection.Qfirst: largest heldout-building Q effect; known supported workers only
selection.QDfirst: largest heldout-building theta for known target difficulty, with difficulty support
selection.QT: quality candidate pool beta >= kth supported beta -3; select k lowest known T_source_effect only if >=k T-known candidates, else unavailable; matched Q baseline restricted to same T-known candidates
selection.QTD: same QT rule using theta at target difficulty; separate QDfirst isolates difficulty without time
selection.origin_time_sensitivity: repeat time-order with independently origin-centered T; no claim source comparability is resolved
selection.metric_sensitivity: fixed-member B8/D10 scoring and reselecting under D10 profiles remain separate analyses
selection.tie_break: worker_id ascending, never heldout actual quality

validation.split: leave one building out; all profile fits, rank calibration, class centroids and selection trained outside heldout building
validation.primary_target: heldout same-task leave-other-person-out quality contrast, evaluated among common history-supported workers; heldout scores define outcomes only, never selection
validation.secondary_target: absolute heldout score with training task-balanced difficulty intercept plus historical worker effect; explicitly distinct from peer-referenced validation
validation.category_prediction: training worker-effect or difficulty-effect centroid of class, not class fitted on target answers
validation.weighting: image equal then building equal primary; record equal and image equal sensitivity; existing declared original room groups sensitivity, overlapping group membership not independent physical rooms
validation.uncertainty: paired building bootstrap 2000 draws for model differences; leave-building-out label stability and jackknife coefficient uncertainty; no claim interchangeability from nonsignificant p-value
validation.v1_replay: fixed1911 scores; fixed1258 manual and1048 development membership; original historical fixed effects verified separately

interpretation: All numerical class and shortlist cutoffs are frozen research candidates and engineering tolerances for this run, not user-approved production rules. No composite score combines Q with T, Semi, scope or personal exclusions.
